name: electronics
description: People sell phones, laptops, consoles and other electronics they own, picked up in person or shipped.

description.description: The item for sale, or the item looked for.

price.description: The price of the item, without shipping.

payment.description: How the item may be paid: direct, shipped, or both.

kind.description: What kind of item it is.

model.description: The brand and model, such as iPhone 13 128 GB.

place.description: Where the item can be picked up, or ships from.

asDescribed.description: In a review of the seller: whether the item was as the post said.

howDealsGo: The seller and the buyer agree in messages on the price and on pickup or shipping, and pay outside Forest. At a pickup the buyer checks the item before paying. Each may review the other. A review of the person who wrote the post names it.
